title: Payroll Services in India: PF, ESI, Professional Tax and Form 16
summary: Monthly payroll with PF, ESI and professional tax filings, TDS on salary and Form 16.
metaTitle: Payroll Services in India: PF, ESI, PT and Form 16
metaDescription: Outsourced payroll for Indian businesses: monthly processing, PF, ESI and professional tax, TDS on salary, Form 16, payslips and final settlements.
heroIntro: Monthly payroll with statutory compliance built in, so salaries, contributions and tax deducted at source are right every month.
overview: Indian payroll touches several regimes at once: provident fund, ESI, professional tax and income tax on salary. We run the cycle, file what is due and issue Form 16 at year-end, tied back to your accounts so payroll costs and liabilities always reconcile.
whatWeDo: Run monthly payroll: attendance, leave, earnings, deductions and net pay.
Calculate and file PF, ESI and professional tax.
Deduct TDS on salary and issue Form 16.
Issue payslips by email or WhatsApp.
Handle joiners, exits and full and final settlements.
Maintain payroll registers and statutory records.

byPlan.cfo: Up to 50 employees. More employees are priced per head.

note: Personal data such as employee records is handled in line with applicable data-protection law, including India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

faqs.a: PF, ESI and professional tax, as applicable to your registrations, plus TDS on salary and Form 16.

faqs.q: Can you handle exits and full and final settlements?
faqs.a: Yes. We process joiners, exits and final settlements as part of the monthly cycle.
